UPSC CSE 2027 | Public Administration Optional Paper 2 – Thematic Syllabus Breakdown
Preparing Public Administration Optional for UPSC CSE 2027? In this session, Ashutosh Sir breaks down the Public Administration Paper 2 syllabus thematically, helping aspirants understand how the syllabus is interconnected and how to approach each major theme strategically.
In this session, you will understand:  
- 📌 Public Administration Paper 2 syllabus explained thematically
- 📌 Major themes and their interlinkages
- 📌 Important areas to focus on for UPSC Mains 2027
- 📌 How to connect different topics for better preparation
- 📌 How to approach Paper 2 with a structured strategy
- 📌 Areas where Current Affairs, governance examples and case studies can add value
- 📌 A practical roadmap for covering Paper 2 effectively
If you are starting or restructuring your Public Administration Optional preparation for UPSC CSE 2027, this session will help you understand what to study, how topics connect, and where to focus your efforts.
🎯 Public Administration Optional by Ashutosh Sir | Sarrthi IAS
